FAQ

Do I need a credit card to sign up?

No. The free plan works without a card. A card is only needed when upgrading to a paid plan.

How does the AI autopilot work?

AI trains on your data: FAQ, docs, past conversations. It answers automatically and hands off to a human operator for complex questions.

What is the 30-day money-back guarantee?

If your conversion doesn't improve in 30 days, we'll refund you — no questions asked. Just contact support.

Can I customize the widget to match my brand?

Yes — color, shape, position, operator avatar, greeting text. In the Business plan — full removal of Prochat branding.

Is there support in Uzbek?

Yes. Our support team works in Russian and Uzbek. The widget also supports multilingual mode.
